title: Other relief available.
bodyText: The relief provided in this chapter is in addition to remedies otherwise available for the same conduct under the common law or other state or federal statutes or rules.
bodyHtml: [§481P-7]  Other relief available.  The relief provided in this chapter is in addition to remedies otherwise available for the same conduct under the common law or other state or federal statutes or rules. [L 1999, c 170, pt of §1]
